verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents reading data out through its public API, including an events endpoint that returns up to 200 events per page with cursor-based pagination. Events are tied to profile activity, which suggests per-contact history is retrievable. However, the evidence never shows filtering events by a specific profile, nor that email sent/opened/clicked engagement is exposed as readable events. missing for 10: documented per-profile event filtering, explicit sent/opened/clicked engagement metrics in read endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact

citations.quote: Returns a maximum of 200 events per page, which can be paginated with cursor-based pagination
